patterns: Direct one-liners dominate: who declares Scheduled Areas (President), which Schedule (Fifth/Sixth), which states (Assam, Meghalaya, Tripura, Mizoram), PESA year (1996).

APPSC-specific: TAC size 'up to 20', Governor's power to exclude Acts (false-statement trap), autonomous region as a unit within a district, ST order amended via AP Reorganisation Act's Sixth Schedule.

Recurring traps: Nagaland/Manipur/Arunachal not Sixth Schedule; CM-to-Home-Ministry report is false (Governor to President); PESA objective is not autonomous regions; 'wherever STs exceed 40%' is false.
PESA Gram Sabha powers: MFP ownership, prevent land alienation, consultation (not consent) for acquisition, recommendation for minor minerals; presiding officer is an ST member, not Sarpanch.
App MCQs lean heavily on 2025-26 current-affairs and AP implementation trivia (Mahotsav, model GPs, MoPR survey) that PYQs never touch; core constitutional items are well covered.
